title: Elixir of Lightning Resistance

sources.title: Elixir of Lightning Resistance
markers: * You gain [[Damage Types#Resistance|Resistance]] to {{DamageType|Lightning}} damage and can no longer be [[Shocked (condition)|Shocked]], [[Electrocuted (condition)|Electrocuted]], [[Jolted (condition)|Jolted]], or otherwise affected by lightning.

sources.title: Elixirs
markers: Only one elixir can be applied at a time

summary: Drink as a Bonus Action. Gain resistance to Lightning damage and protection against Shocked, Electrocuted and Jolted until the next Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Gain resistance to Lightning damage and protection against Shocked, Electrocuted and Jolted until the next Long Rest.
fields.Stacking: Replaces another elixir effect. Drinking a different elixir can end this effect early.
fields.Creative use: Drink before a fight where this effect will matter.
fields.Throw: Action. Consume one bottle. Applies the listed protection to creatures within 3 ft of impact. The item source does not give a separate thrown duration.
fields.Crafting: Combine Salts of Copper Shavings with any Suspension.
fields.Base value: 20 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Additional protection: Grants immunity to Static Discharge Aura.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
